name: theia-nbdime-diff
displayName: Notebook Diff for GitLens and SCM
description: Automatically show Jupyter notebook diffs with the installed nbdime CLI in Theia and VS Code.

commands.title: Open Active Notebook Diff with nbdime

notebookDiff.enabled.description: Automatically open nbdime when an .ipynb text diff is opened by GitLens, Source Control, or another extension.

notebookDiff.replaceOriginalDiff.description: Close the JSON diff tab only once the nbdime viewer has rendered successfully.

notebookDiff.hideUnchanged.description: Initially collapse unchanged notebook cells in the nbdime viewer.
